title: AeroServerBar
description: This plugin port Purpur's Tpsbar and Rambar to Folia Server.
body:
# AeroServerBar

This plugin ported Purpur's Tpsbar and Rambar to Folia.

Our code is based on purpur-server source code. We only ported it to Folia.

Check out purpur [here](https://github.com/PurpurMC/Purpur)

### State of this plugin
Working as expected! See screenshow below.

![Example Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ddc47950f3895ce1479faddbe62df260f84f14d.png)

### Permission:
/tpsbar - bukkit.command.tpsbar

/rambar - bukkit.command.rambar
